Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentLoanAgreement: LoanAgreement = LoanAgreement.allInstance()->any(o|o.Content = 'Loan Agreement'),
		currentLoanRequests: Set(LoanRequest) = LoanRequest.allInstance()->select(o|o.Status = 'SUBMITTED'),
		isCurrentLoanRequestExists: Boolean = currentLoanRequests.isEmpty() = false
	precondition:
		isCurrentLoanRequestExists = true
	postcondition:
		let newLoanAgreement: LoanAgreement in
		newLoanAgreement.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAgreement.allInstance()->includes(newLoanAgreement) and
		currentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = newLoanAgreement and
		newLoanAgreement.Content = 'Loan Agreement' and
		result = true
}
